title: Convert scheduler domain value types to @freezed instead of hand-rolled or missing equality
rule: naming/placement — "Domain/state models are immutable @freezed classes; never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes"
why: 9 of the 13 classes hand-write ==/hashCode/toString (delta_value.dart's 4 types, goal_entity.dart's PaceTarget subtypes, overdue_types.dart's 3 types) — correct today, but every future field addition must remember to update the hand-written equality by hand (Fowler shotgun-surgery risk that @freezed removes entirely). The other 4 (SchedulerCompletion, SchedulerContentItem, SchedulerStage, SchedulerOrderItem — the scheduler-local adapter DTOs returned across every repository interface in this batch) have NO equality override at all, so they compare by identity; any future Set/contains/expect(x,y)-by-value usage of these types will silently pass or fail for the wrong reason.
recommendation: Convert to @freezed, or record the zero-codegen-dependency rationale (stated in overdue_types.dart's docstring) as an explicit documented judgment call in coding-standards.md so it stops being flagged.
acceptance_criteria: Each listed class is either converted to @freezed, or the deliberate non-freezed choice is recorded in coding-standards.md's judgment-call list.
A Rule-0 grep/lint flags hand-written operator== under lib/features/*/domain/ (excluding generated files) so the decision stays enforced either way.
